source: NYC DCP MapPLUTO (64uk-42ks) via NYC Open Data
where: borough='BK' AND latitude between '40.6830' and '40.7010' AND longitude between '-73.9470' and '-73.9100'
crs: xcoord/ycoord are NY State Plane Long Island (EPSG:2263), US survey feet; latitude/longitude WGS84
trim: Kept only lots with centroid inside the survey polygon (grid x > -40 m, z -340..1060 m, west of the Bushwick Ave centreline +45 m); X/Z are grid metres (+x east, +z south, origin Throop Ave x Kosciuszko St centrelines, grid rotated 8.7 deg from State Plane north-east)
